top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks most clearly unite the magic-wavelength control principle with a mature, independently reproducible experimental capability. Katori and Ye provide the most defensible compact attribution for the central concept and defining realization, provided the award remains confined to optical lattice clocks rather than later metrological advances or applications.
recusal_note: I have no identified personal collaboration or institutional connection to Katori or Ye. My work and WACQT leadership are in superconducting-circuit quantum technology, not optical lattice clocks; no recusal-triggering conflict is apparent from the supplied profile.
